# Use calendar formatter helpers to create complete localized ranges

calDateTimeFormatter explicitly tells callers to obtain the whole string rather than assemble date/time pieces. formatInterval handles missing task dates through Fluent messages and uses formatRange for complete endpoints, while formatTimeInterval delegates missing endpoints to formatTime. Preserve these formatters when building UI range labels. The accepted unit fixture allows multiple locale formatting variants; tests were read, not run.

Scope: Calendar whole-range formatting API.
